content: math/rand/v2 (Go 1.22+) auto-seeds by default — no manual seed needed. Key function for slice selection: rand.IntN(n) returns [0,n). Random element pattern: quotes[rand.IntN(len(quotes))]. N[Int] generic function available. Top-level functions are goroutine-safe. v2 differences from v1: removed Read, renamed Intn to IntN, added N[] generic, PCG and ChaCha8 sources available for explicit seeding.
